```plato
//==
// # ScientificData — derived functions for ITimeSampled
//
// Bodies for the `ITimeSampled` interface declared in
// `scientific-data.concepts.plato`: a time-indexed collection of SampleCount
// samples, each with a TimeAt(index). The helpers are the emptiness,
// index-validity and endpoint-time summaries; sample times are Instants, so a
// span is their IDifference (a Duration). Pure expressions only; all inputs are
// immutable and evaluation is side-effect free. See `README.md` for naming and
// unit conventions.

library ScientificData
{
    //==
    // # ITimeSampled
    //
    // A time-indexed collection: SampleCount samples, each with a TimeAt(index).
    // Times are Instants, so a span is their IDifference (a Duration).

    // True when the collection holds no samples.
    IsEmpty(self: ITimeSampled): Boolean
        => self.SampleCount == 0;
```
